# Pinned black level for this set, instead of deriving one from calibrate\.
#
# Deriving it is not equivalent to a real calibration run: this set's calibrate\ folder holds only
# three frames from a single load, while a real run accumulates the minimum over a whole session.
# The binarization threshold is measured from this value, so the difference decides borderline frames.
#
# The value below is 0, not the 3 that a real layout produced under the previous detector. That is not
# a correction - the reference patch moved. It used to be cols [120,160) x rows [30,50), above the
# mask, where this capture reads 3; it is now cols [40,80) x rows [120,160), level with the mask, where
# every loading frame of this set reads exactly 0. Any black level saved by an older layout is a
# measurement of a different patch and does not carry over, which is why the component no longer reads
# one back.
#
# Refresh this from a real layout's saved settings once a full calibration run has been done against
# the current patch.
blacklevel = 0
